Booking & Prices

At aether art space, we offer fair and affordable pricing, so you can focus on what matters most – the creativity behind your shoot.

Our studio is designed to elevate the creative process, with flexible packages that cater to different needs, whether you're a model, photographer, or business looking to capture stunning visuals.

We also offer a variety of extras on-site exclusive to our studio in Budapest, including analogue camera rentals, clothing, film, and more, to help bring your vision to life.
